svg.title: Built on
svg.desc: 23 standards, platform policies and laws the daily scout watches, and 20 reviewed, pinned agent and security projects. Security standards: OWASP ASVS, OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP LLM & Agentic Top 10, OWASP MASVS, NIST SP 800-63, SLSA, MCP specification, CISA KEV catalog, OpenSSF Scorecard. Formats & quality: WCAG, Core Web Vitals, OpenTelemetry logs, RFC 9457 Problem Details, Design Tokens. Platform policies: Claude Code permissions & hooks docs, Apple App Review Guidelines, Google Play target API level, GitHub Actions security changes. Law & regulation: EU Cyber Resilience Act, EU AI Act, CCPA regulations / GPC, GDPR. Reviewed agent & security projects (pinned): superpowers, Sentry skills, Perplexity Bumblebee, ponytail, caveman, Cloudflare security-audit skill, frontend-design, NVIDIA SkillSpector, Cisco AI Defense skill-scanner, code-modernization, docker-destructive-guardrails, ECC database-migrations, firebase-security-rules-auditor, grill-me / grilling, Playwright test agents, sandbox-runtime, skill-creator, Supabase agent skill, Trail of Bits skills, Vercel React best practices.
svg.text: Built on 23 standards & policies and 20 reviewed projects
Each one is watched by the daily scout: a new version or a new source arrives as a pull request with a recommendation.
